newsitem.title: USA: James Earl Ray back in Tennessee hospital.
newsitem.headline: James Earl Ray back in Tennessee hospital.

text.p: James Earl Ray, the assassin of civil rights leader Martin Luther King Jr., was back in a Nashville hospital in fair condition on Tuesday, hospital officials said.
Ray, 68, returned to Columbia Memorial Hospital in Nashville from a prison hospital where he was moved last week after emerging from a coma.
His family has said Ray suffers from cirrhosis of the liver, though he never drank, and that his liver and kidneys are failing.
Ray confessed to the 1968 slaying of King in Memphis, although he later recanted and claimed he was set up.
